history.summary: Saved plan to docs/PLAN.md; added §30 loot-shooter core specification.
Scaffold: LICENSE, README, .gitignore, CMake C++20 skeleton, ASSETS.toml, CREDITS.md, 4 Kenney CC0 packs.
SDL3 + Vulkan 1.3 triangle; validation only if installed; headless + 3 s window smoke tests pass (0 validation msgs, layer absent).
Added BUILD_PLAN.md with Standing rules (every hourly run) and step table; created build_state.json history log.

Moved BUILD_PLAN.md and build_state.json into docs/. Expanded plan from 12 to 45 ~1-hour steps through a minimal playable vertical slice (loot drops/pickup/inventory, XP, HUD/UI, key bindings, Breach room + mini-boss, Kenney audio, save round-trip, playtest passes); split oversized M0/M1 steps; each step has Does/Files/Done.

CI workflow .github/workflows/ci.yml (ubuntu-24.04, clang, Ninja, lavapipe forced via VK_DRIVER_FILES, validation layers installed, ctest -LE window); not pushed. Bug fix: Ubuntu 24.04 has no SDL3 package, so CMake now falls back to FetchContent SDL3 release-3.4.18 (COE_FETCH_SDL3 forces it; CI uses SDL_UNIX_CONSOLE_BUILD). Done check: YAML parses; ctest -LE window passes with system SDL3 (GCC) and in a CI emulation (clang, fetched static SDL3, lavapipe-only); full ctest incl. window also green. Plan: step 5 lint stdlib-only + runs in CI; step 7 adds asan preset + ASan/UBSan CI job, Windows/clang-tidy/format deferred. Magewar: ~/game has only .github issue templates, no workflows; corrected PLAN.md §1. Its headless logic-test runner matches our headless-ctest approach.

Added PLAN.md §31 (original loot architecture: Patterns with merge modes, requires/forbids constraints, Workshop signatures, weight model, Consecrations, Vigils/Omens, Ember Mark item codes, balance patches, level layers) and §32 What we learned (public BLCM/apocalyptech docs only; no game files or keys). Refined §30.2. BUILD_PLAN: inserted 5 steps (27 Patterns + constraints, 29 Ember Mark codes, 30 Balance patch loader, 35 Weight model + Vigil plumbing, 43 Consecrations); old steps 27-45 renumbered to 28-50; steps 40/46/47 text refined. Plan now has 50 steps; total_steps field left unchanged per instruction. next_step unchanged (5).

Asset license lint: tools/check_assets.py (stdlib tomllib) registered as ctests asset_license_lint (repo check) and asset_license_lint_selftest (13 temp-fixture cases); Python3>=3.11 found via find_package. 'Top-level folder' = each dir directly under assets/, with vendor grouping folders holding only sub-folders (assets/kenney/) expanded so each pack is a unit; loose files must be covered; entries need name/path/license/source, path inside assets/, existing, unique, and a CREDITS.md row (manifest/credits can't drift). Done check: temp dirs assets/zz-untracked-tmp and assets/kenney/zz-untracked-tmp each failed the lint, then removed; full ctest (incl. window) green, build warning-free. Bug fix: smoke tests write triangle.ppm to the cwd, leaving a stray untracked file at repo root when run from there; removed it and added *.ppm to .gitignore. ASSETS.toml header documents the rule. Plan: step 45 now extends check_assets.py with a --paths-from sounds.toml mode. Magewar: ~/game credits third-party assets (Kenney, Quaternius) in a credit list and ships upstream License.txt/LICENSE files beside addons/textures; our approach matches its spirit with a machine-checked manifest + CREDITS.md, and all 4 Kenney packs keep their upstream License.txt. No mismatch with PLAN.md references.

Asset cooker stub: tools/asset_cooker CLI ([--root] [--out build/cooked] PATH..., dirs walked) validates .gltf/.glb/.png/.ogg containers (PNG sig/IHDR/IEND, OggS, GLB magic/v2/length/JSON chunk, glTF JSON object with asset), follows glTF external URIs (missing/out-of-root = error, referenced files cooked too), copies verbatim and writes a deterministic manifest.json (source, cooked, type, bytes, FNV-1a 64 hash, deps); any error = exit 1 and no manifest; refuses to cook into assets/. 'cook' CMake target cooks all assets/ (1192 files, all valid). Done check: `build/debug/asset_cooker assets/kenney/blaster-kit` from repo root wrote build/cooked/manifest.json with 86 files (40 glb + 46 png; glb deps -> Textures/colormap.png); identical on re-run; new ctests asset_cooker_selftest (15 fixture cases), asset_cooker_blaster_kit + asset_cooker_manifest_check (tools/asset_cooker/check_manifest.py: every source file listed, cooked bytes/hash match; verified it fails when an entry is removed). Full ctest 7/7 green, build warning-free (GCC), clang -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror clean. Bug fix: README said ctest 'runs both smoke tests' (stale since step 5); updated and added cooker section. Plan: step 11 runtime loads via cooked/manifest.json and cooker swaps URI scan for fastgltf; step 27 Pattern check lives in the cooker. Magewar: ~/game relies on Godot's import step (.import files with source_file, dest_files, deps, hashed dest names in .godot/imported); our cooker reinterprets this as a central manifest with source/cooked/deps/hash. No mismatch with PLAN.md §23/§24 references.

ADR-0001 docs/adr/0001-language-and-libraries.md (Context/Decision/Consequences): C++20 over Rust (M0 code exists, native Vulkan/Jolt/ImGui ecosystem; safety via ASan/UBSan CI + validation + tests), FetchContent-only pinned SYSTEM deps (replaces PLAN §23 'vcpkg or CPM'), SDL3 system-or-FetchContent policy (release-3.4.18, COE_FETCH_SDL3, CI console build), per-step library table (GLM, VMA, fastgltf+simdjson, toml++, Jolt, doctest, ImGui, stb_truetype, miniaudio; EnTT/RmlUi/Lua/net deferred). README links it. asan configure/build/test presets: COE_SANITIZE=ON adds -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -fno-omit-frame-pointer to all targets; CMakeLists sets ctest env ASAN_OPTIONS (leaks, stack-use-after-return, init-order), UBSAN_OPTIONS halt_on_error, LSAN_OPTIONS suppressions=tools/sanitizers/lsan.supp (documented, empty) and VK_LOADER_DISABLE_DYNAMIC_LIBRARY_UNLOADING=1. Sanitizer noise: smoke_headless first failed with 2-3 x 128 B LSan leaks in '<unknown module>' frames (Mesa pthread_once allocs, RADV and lavapipe) because the Vulkan loader dlclose()s ICDs/layers at vkDestroyInstance; fixed with the loader's own leak-tool switch instead of suppressions, so leak checks stay fully on. CI: single job became a debug/asan matrix (two jobs, fail-fast off, per-preset _deps cache, ctest timeout 300, vm.mmap_rnd_bits=28 for clang-18 ASan on the asan job); YAML parses (PyYAML), presets JSON valid. Done check: `cmake --preset asan && ctest --test-dir build/asan -LE window` 6/6 passed (GCC 16, RADV), also `ctest --preset asan`; CI emulation (clang 23, COE_SANITIZE + fetched static SDL3 console build, lavapipe) 6/6 passed, only warnings in SDL _deps; verified UBSan is fatal (signed overflow probe exits 1 on GCC and clang). Debug clean rebuild 0 warnings, full ctest 7/7 incl. window. No ASan/UBSan bugs in existing code (renderer, asset_cooker selftests clean). Bug fix: BUILD_PLAN step 6 was missing its commit hash (68d1c88). Plan: standing rule now includes asan ctest from step 8; step 8 adds coe_add_test() helper so tests in engine/game/tests subdirs get the sanitizer env (CMake 3.25 can only set test props in the defining dir); step 11 reads manifest.json with simdjson; step 12 uses toml++; new step 51 (post-slice) for clang-format/clang-tidy/Windows MSVC CI; PLAN §23 language/build rows and §25 unit tests (doctest)/builds updated; total_steps 51. Magewar: ~/game keeps no decision records (decisions only in the Bible/commit messages) and its docs/ is the COGITO template's Sphinx manual (PLAN §1 corrected); its headless runner fails on any runtime ERROR line before the pass banner, which our fatal UBSan + LSan + validation-error-fails policy reinterprets; no CI there to mirror.

Engine/game split + fixed-timestep loop. Renderer moved (git mv) to engine/render as static lib coe_engine (includes rooted at repo: engine/..., game/...; shader SPIR-V build moved to engine/CMakeLists.txt); game/ builds covenant from game/main.cpp; CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY keeps ./build/<preset>/covenant and asset_cooker paths; shared coe_warnings INTERFACE target. coe::FixedTimestep (engine/core) accumulates in exact integer ns*hz units so N s of frame time always gives exactly N*hz ticks (no float drift), 60 Hz, alpha() in [0,1), 0.25 s hitch clamp with droppedNs(); monotonicNs() steady clock. Placeholder game::SpinDemo rotates the triangle per tick and renders lerp(prev,curr,alpha) through a 4-byte vertex push constant (FrameParams::spin; wrapped after blending). --seconds N prints frames + fixed ticks and fails on tick mismatch vs (elapsed-dropped)*60. coe_add_test(NAME COMMAND [WORKING_DIRECTORY] [LABELS] [PROPERTIES]) in cmake/CoeTesting.cmake applies COE_SANITIZER_TEST_ENV (ASAN/UBSAN/LSAN_OPTIONS + VK_LOADER_DISABLE_DYNAMIC_LIBRARY_UNLOADING) in the defining dir; all tests use it (root tools tests, game/ smoke tests with WORKING_DIRECTORY build/<preset>, tests/fixed_timestep); coe_verify_tests() walks our source dirs (skipping the build tree/_deps) and fails configure on any plain add_test (verified: an injected add_test(NAME bypass) failed configure). Done check: full debug ctest 8/8 incl. smoke_window (validation on, 0 errors/warnings, RADV RX 6950 XT); `covenant --seconds 3` logged 'frames: 381 in 3.00s (127 fps)' and 'fixed ticks: 180 @ 60 Hz (expected 180, 0.000s dropped)'; `ctest --test-dir build/asan -N --show-only=json-v1` shows all 4 sanitizer/loader vars on all 8 tests incl. game/ and tests/ dirs; asan build + `ctest --test-dir build/asan -LE window` 7/7 passed; debug clean rebuild 0 warnings (GCC 16), clang 23 -Werror build clean + ctest -LE window 7/7; new ctest fixed_timestep (180 ticks at 30/60/144/240 fps and 3 jitter seeds, alpha fraction/monotonic, hitch clamp 15 ticks, 120 Hz, spin lerp + wrap). No game processes left running. Bug fix: CI _deps cache key hashed only the root CMakeLists.txt; now '**/CMakeLists.txt' + 'cmake/**'. Plan: standing rule requires coe_add_test for every test; step 9 latches input edges per fixed tick (no dropped/doubled presses), mouse look per render frame; step 10 extends FrameParams and replaces SpinDemo; step 20 adds a single doctest runner via coe_add_test and ports test_fixed_timestep; step 39 adds a frame-cap/vsync option; PLAN §23 gains a Main loop row; README gains Layout + coe_add_test notes. Magewar: ~/game uses Godot defaults (no physics_ticks_per_second override, so 60 physics ticks/s, Jolt) with movement in _physics_process (cogito_player.gd) and run/max_fps=120; no physics interpolation enabled. Our 60 Hz tick matches; render interpolation is our reinterpretation; its fps cap is scheduled as an option in step 39 (sim rate unaffected). Its MultiplayerSynchronizer replicates position/rotation/velocity, which the fixed tick will carry for future host-authoritative net. No other mismatch.

Input layer. engine/input/input.{hpp,cpp} (coe::input, in coe_engine): Action enum MoveForward/Back/Left/Right, Jump, Fire, Aim, Reload, Sprint, Dash, Crouch, Interact, Weapon1-4; ActionMap of Bindings (SDL scancode = physical key, or mouse button), several per action (held while any is down), defaults WASD/Space/LMB fire/RMB aim/R/LShift/Q dash/C+LCtrl crouch/F/1-4; InputState::handleEvent() per render frame (key auto-repeat ignored, SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_FOCUS_LOST releases everything with release edges, late key-ups make no stray edge); consumeTick() per fixed tick returns held bits + pressed/released edges + saturating press count latched since the previous tick and clears them; takeLook() per render frame returns accumulated relative mouse motion. game/main.cpp: relative mouse mode (non-fatal if refused), events fed per frame, one consumeTick per fixed tick, look applied per frame at 0.25 deg/count (yaw added to the placeholder triangle until the step-10 camera, pitch clamped +-89 deg), --input-debug prints per-tick +/- edges with held set and per-frame look, --input-script pushes 13 scripted synthetic SDL events through SDL_PushEvent at fixed loop iterations and fails unless every scripted press reached exactly one tick (no edge left latched). Done check: new ctest `input` (tests/test_input.cpp, coe_add_test): synthetic SDL_Event key/button/motion/focus structs map to actions; a Jump tap pressed and released across two 0-tick frames is seen by exactly one tick (pressed+released, not held) and never again; Fire pressed in a 2-tick frame is pressed on tick 1 and only held on tick 2; double tap between ticks counts 2; repeats and C/LCtrl multi-binding produce one edge; focus loss; rebind Jump to Mouse X1 (duplicates ignored, out-of-range button ignored); look accumulates over a 0-tick frame and ticks never consume it; 4000-frame jittered loop (1-41 ms frames, 3 seeds, both 0-tick and 2+-tick frames occur) sees presses == taps. New window ctest `input_script_window` (`covenant --seconds 2 --input-debug --input-script`): printed '+Jump -Jump', '+MoveForward', look dx 40 -> yaw -0.175 rad, '+Fire', '+Reload -Reload +Weapon2 -Weapon2', '+Jump -Fire', '-Jump', '-MoveForward'; Jump 2/2, MoveForward/Fire/Weapon2/Reload 1/1 presses, 120 ticks at ~130 fps, 0 validation messages. Debug build warning-free (GCC 16), full debug ctest 10/10 incl. window; asan build + `ctest --test-dir build/asan -LE window` 8/8 (sanitizer env on all 10 tests incl. new ones); clang -Werror build + ctest -LE window 8/8 (temp build dir removed). No covenant processes left (pgrep empty). Bug fix (from step 7/8): asan window runs (smoke_window, now input_script_window) failed LSan with 2 x 96 B allocated inside system libwayland-client 1.26 wl_display_read_events during SDL_Init(VIDEO) (reproduced at HEAD 75b1840 before any step-9 change); added a documented `leak:wl_display_read_events` entry to tools/sanitizers/lsan.supp per its rules (system lib only), both asan window tests now pass. Plan: step 9 text lists all four Move actions + debug/script flags; step 14 consumes TickInput (axes, Jump on wasPressed edge) with look from takeLook() per frame, 0.25 deg/count, pitch clamp +-89 deg, replaces the triangle-yaw placeholder; step 38 turns relative mouse mode off and releaseAll()s gameplay actions while UI screens are open; step 39 serialises ActionMap (scancode names / 'Mouse N', unknown names keep defaults), invert-Y default off, hold-vs-toggle Crouch/Aim, gamepad bindings + stick look noted post-slice (PLAN §20); PLAN §23 Main loop row notes input timing; README Layout + --input-debug. Magewar: ~/game project.godot [input] maps actions to physical_keycode (WASD, Space jump, C crouch, Shift sprint, R reload, F interact, E interact2/equipment panel, 1-4 quickslots, Tab inventory, Esc menu, Alt free look) plus joypad buttons for each; our scancode bindings reinterpret physical keys, same layout except Q dash (Magewar has no dash) and LCtrl as a second crouch. cogito_player.gd applies mouse look in _input() per event (MOUSE_SENS 0.25 deg/count, head pitch clamp +-90, captured mouse) and movement/jump/crouch edges (is_action_just_pressed) in _physics_process, which our per-frame look + per-tick latched edges match. Its options loader defaults INVERT_Y to true and has toggle crouch; scheduled in step 39 (invert off by default, hold/toggle option). Magewar's E-key equipment panel bypasses the action map with a raw keycode check; we keep all gameplay keys in the ActionMap so step 39 rebinding covers them. No mismatch left unscheduled.

Math, camera and depth buffer. GLM 1.0.3 via FetchContent (github release tarball, URL_HASH SHA256 6775e472..., SYSTEM, GLM_BUILD_LIBRARY/TESTS/INSTALL OFF so glm::glm is header-only INTERFACE; include(FetchContent) now unconditional in root CMakeLists); coe_engine links glm::glm PUBLIC with GLM_FORCE_RADIANS + GLM_FORCE_DEPTH_ZERO_TO_ONE. engine/render/camera.{hpp,cpp}: coe::Camera {position, yaw, pitch, fovYDeg=75 vertical, nearZ=0.05, kMaxPitch 89 deg}; right-handed +Y up, -Z forward, positive yaw turns left; view() = inverse(T*Ry*Rx); projection(aspect) Vulkan clip (Y flipped) reverse-Z infinite far (depth = near/distance). vk_renderer: depth format picked by format features (D32_SFLOAT, fallback D32_SFLOAT_S8_UINT; +TRANSFER_SRC headless), GpuImage helper createImage/destroyImage, window depth image created/destroyed with the swapchain and shared by the 2 frames in flight (UNDEFINED->DEPTH_ATTACHMENT barrier with EARLY|LATE_FRAGMENT_TESTS write->read|write), clear 0 / compare GREATER / depth write, cull BACK + CCW, pipeline depthAttachmentFormat; recordTriangle -> recordScene; PushConstants {viewProj, model} static_assert 128 B; FrameParams {Camera camera; glm::mat4 model} (spin removed; no default args so callers must pass a real pose). shaders/basic.{vert,frag} replace triangle.*: 36-vertex unit cube from gl_VertexIndex (CCW from outside), Lambert + 0.2 ambient, ember albedo, fixed light normalize(0.6,0.6,0.55). game/core/cube_demo.hpp replaces spin_demo.hpp: yaw 0.75 rad/s + pitch 0.45 rad/s per fixed tick from a tilted start (0.6, 0.45) at 2.2 m, renderModel(alpha) lerps then wraps. game/main.cpp: mouse look -> camera yaw/pitch (pitch clamp from Camera::kMaxPitch), model from sim.renderModel(alpha); headless renders the tick-0 pose. Headless check reads back colour + depth into one buffer, writes cube.ppm (was triangle.ppm): corner must be clear colour with depth exactly 0, centre lit (r>90, warm) with depth in (cube-origin depth, 1] (proves depth exists and the front face wins), and >=4 cube samples with red spread >20. Done check: covenant --headless with validation on: corner rgb(5,5,13) depth 0.00000, centre rgb(142,71,21) depth 0.03261 > origin 0.02273, 39 cube samples red 51..229, 0 validation messages; input_script_window still passes (120 ticks, 40 counts of look, all scripted presses once, 0 validation messages); new ctest camera (defaults, reverse-Z near->1 / near/d / inf->0 / monotonic / behind w<0, NDC axes incl. Vulkan up = -y, vertical FOV edge = -1 for aspect 1 and 2, horizontal scales with aspect, yaw +90 deg looks -X, pitch up, translation); fixed_timestep spin test ported to CubeDemo (both axes, wrap, rigid model matrix). Verification: debug clean rebuild warning-free, ctest debug 11/11 incl. window tests; asan ctest -LE window 9/9; clang -Werror temp build (build/clang-tmp, removed) ctest -LE window 9/9; pgrep covenant empty. Bug fixes: first light direction left the start-pose centre face at r=85 (barely above ambient) -> light moved so the centre face is clearly lit. Plan changes: step 12 moves per-frame data (viewProj, camera pos, light) into a per-frame UBO because push constants are full at 128 B, and adds 2x MSAA (Magewar msaa_3d); step 14 builds on the camera already taking look (controller owns yaw/pitch, eye height from Magewar Neck +0.7 m, crouch -0.9 m), cube demo replaced by greybox; step 19 ADS FOV spec (hip 75 vertical -> per-family ADS FOV, Magewar staff 55 / Cogito pistols 65, 0.2 s tween, sensitivity scaled by tan ratio, viewmodel fixed 75 deg FOV). Magewar notes (read-only): cogito_player.tscn Camera3D has no fov/near/far override -> Godot defaults 75 deg vertical keep_height, near 0.05, far 4000; we match FOV/near and replace far with infinite reverse-Z (intentional mismatch); Magewar project.godot msaa_3d=2x (scheduled step 12), viewmodel_fov 75 (step 19), max_fps 120 (frame cap already step 39); wieldable_staff ADS 55 deg / 0.2 s tween (step 19).

Mesh pipeline + glTF loading. fastgltf 0.9.1, VMA 3.4.0, simdjson 4.6.11 via FetchContent release tarballs with URL_HASH SHA256 + SYSTEM; fastgltf's own simdjson fetch has no hash, so we build simdjson's single-header amalgamation as coe_simdjson aliased simdjson::simdjson first. New CPU-only coe_assets lib shared by asset_cooker and coe_engine: loadGltfMesh (default scene DFS with cycle guard, baked world transforms, inverse-transpose normals, winding flip on det<0, generated normals, non-indexed -> sequential, non-triangle primitives skipped, baseColorFactor + doubleSided per submesh, errors on short buffers / bad indices / 0 triangles), inspectGltf for the cooker, CookedManifest (simdjson DOM; format/version/count/path checks; resolve() verifies size + fnv1a64 of file and deps). Renderer: VMA images + buffers, uploadMesh -> MeshId via staging, vertex input, cull + double-sided pipelines, FrameParams draws list; shaders take attributes. covenant depends on `cook`, loads --model (default Kenney blaster-a.glb) from --cooked, fits it to 1 m, side-on, tumbled by TumbleDemo (renamed CubeDemo). Done check: `covenant --headless` (validation on, 0 messages) printed '[mesh] ...blaster-a.glb: 470 triangles, 820 vertices, 2 submesh(es)' and '[headless] corner rgb(5,5,13) depth 0.00000 | centre rgb(154,154,154) depth 0.02363 (model origin 0.02331) | 30 model samples, luma 51..252' -> RESULT: PASS; mesh.ppm inspected visually (blaster in profile at centre). New ctests gltf_loader (synthetic glTF: mirrored child under translated parent, winding/normals/bounds/submeshes/material; 6 error files; manifest size/hash/dep/../absolute/count/format/malformed errors), gltf_cooked_blaster_kit (40 cooked models load, 13638 tris; blaster-a 470 tris, 2 submeshes, unit normals), smoke_headless_missing_model + smoke_headless_bad_cooked_dir (must print an [assets] error, fail on any sanitizer report or RESULT: PASS); cooker self-test +9 glTF cases (data-URI + external .bin cook, malformed JSON, accessor/bufferView overruns, short .bin, index out of range, no POSITION, remote URI). Debug build warning-free (GCC 16), debug ctest 15/15 incl. window tests; asan build + ctest -LE window 13/13; clang 23 -Werror build + ctest -LE window 13/13 (temp dir removed); pgrep covenant empty. Bug fixes: no test had a TIMEOUT (a hung GPU/window test would block ctest; CI relied on --timeout 300 only) -> coe_add_test applies TIMEOUT 120 s (COE_TEST_TIMEOUT) unless PROPERTIES sets one; renderer findMemoryType could return UINT32_MAX unchecked -> replaced by VMA; cooker URIs were percent-decoded twice (now fastgltf's decoded path); cooker fixtures bad5/bad8 lacked asset.version so they failed for the wrong reason (fixed); `cook` target now a real output-tracked custom command (re-cooks only when assets or the cooker change). Plan: step 11 text rewritten; step 12 boxes reuse the mesh path (in-code unit-cube MeshData + DrawItem per box, inverse-transpose normals for non-uniform scale); step 14 references tumble_demo.hpp; step 21 adds Cogito viewmodel transform + colormap texturing (stb_image, sampler/descriptor, KHR_texture_transform baked into UVs); ADR-0001 policy now URL + URL_HASH (SDL3's fallback GIT_TAG fetch noted, to move on its next bump) with VMA/fastgltf/simdjson pins. Magewar: ~/game uses the same Kenney blaster-kit GLBs through Godot's importer inside Cogito wieldable scenes (blaster rotated 180 deg about Y, scale 0.8 under the camera) and textures from the colormap; we load the same files through the cooked manifest and schedule the viewmodel transform + texturing for step 21 (no mismatch left unscheduled). Commit a5c4b7d.
